performance.verdict: ROAS math is broken: 5.24x on sparse purchases, not a scaling signal.

findings.text: 28-day ROAS of 5.24x rests on only 36 purchases across 45 days; 3-day purchase signal (Sep 5–7: 1,1,2) vs prior 3 (Sep 2–4: 2,4,1) is flat-to-declining on +54.79% more spend. Revenue per dollar is deteriorating, not compounding.

ROAS delta of -64.09% week-over-week with spend up 54.79% ($64.34/day) confirms costs are outpacing revenue. Daily revenue last 3 days: $136.45, $192.95, $191.02 — well below the Aug 29 single-day spike of $1,727.93 that flatters the 28-day average.

GBP actions dropped to 0 for 8 consecutive days (Sep 1–7) vs 33–37/day prior week — gbp_7d_pct -100%. Local organic intent has gone dark; cause unknown but timing aligns with no new posts or an account flag.

5 SOW milestones are overdue: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (due Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails (all due Aug 31). Blocking attribution truth and funnel conversion work.

IG reach is trending down in the 3-day window (Sep 5–7: 854, 711, 686) vs prior 3 (Sep 2–4: 875, 883, 975), -~28% off recent peak. Spend held flat; falling reach on flat spend is early creative fatigue.

suggestions.text: Hold Meta spend flat at ~$60/day; re-check ROAS after 3 more purchase days before any scale move.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend is held at its current ~$60/day level. The 28-day 5.24x ROAS is inflated by a single $1,727.93 revenue day (Aug 29); the last 3 days show only $136–$192/day revenue against $58–$63/day spend. Success check: if 3 consecutive days each show ROAS ≥ 4x on Windsor attribution, bring the scale conversation back — target re-check Sep 11.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore GBP listing: 8 zero-action days (Sep 1–7) vs 33–37/day prior — confirm no suspension or ownership issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for every day Sep 1–7 after averaging 33–37 actions/day the week prior (gbp_7d_pct -100%). Log into Google Business Profile and check for suspensions, ownership prompts, or missing info flags. Success check: gbp_actions return to ≥ 15/day within 3 days of fix. If no account issue is found, post a fresh update and monitor by Sep 11.

suggestions.text: Queue one new real-footage creative into BWS - Sales - Muslims; IG reach down ~28% over last 3 days on flat spend.
suggestions.monday_update: IG reach on the active campaign has declined from ~975 (Sep 2) to 686 (Sep 7) over 3 days with spend unchanged, a probable fatigue signal. Pull one approved real-facility or product creative from Haney's July 21 Drive folder and introduce it into the BWS - Sales - Muslims ad set alongside the existing creative — do not pause the incumbent yet. Success check: reach stabilises above 850/day within 4 days of launch, by Sep 12.
